name: CAROL sell callback manipulates liquidity-rebalancing reserves
summary: sell pays ETH through an external router before computing the LP burn from current ethReserved. The seller callback reduces that reserve with CAROL-to-WETH trades, causing the subsequent burn to consume nearly all protocol LP; flash-loan spot manipulation also inflates bond-token credit.

loss.notes: Gross depletion of the CAROL/WETH pool reserves, excluding the preparatory attacker liquidity contribution. LP burning is supporting custody evidence; it is not added to loss again.

sources.note: Identity/age/first-use review: Etherscan V2 getsourcecode https://basescan.org/address/0x26fe408bbd7a490feb056da8e2d1e007938e5685#code identifies direct CAROLProtocol with immutable token/pair/router pointers, no delegatecall, upgrade or selfdestruct path. Source-4 creates it at block 3652088 index 13; eth_getCode at 3652088, 7279799 and 7279800 hashes to 0xc518a74b7a49ed88d826ba0d44d32f42a24f747a887708285f4c718c814b6402. Etherscan V2 txlist(protocol, ascending, offset 10000) windows [3652088,7281000], [6109493,7281000], [6653115,7281000] yield 10,000/10,000/9,050 rows, 29,048 distinct hashes. eth_getLogs(Sell topic 0x846c37eef631e0943682d87352ec117c20008eb7f425c9b85ac011a6d4774cc0, same range) yields 7,749 sells; source-1 is the sole internal sell. All earlier recipients are direct transaction EOAs: sell passes msg.sender to swapExactTokensForETH, so they cannot execute a seller callback in pre-EIP-7702 Base. Later txlist [7281001,latest] has 733 rows through 8018120; Sell logs through head 52194451 add 21, all direct EOA sells. No recurrence of the callback path. Pre-exploit owner history includes 28 price-balancer changes (last block 7243768 to 500); the nonnegative multiplier changes loss size, not callback safety. Token getsourcecode https://basescan.org/address/0x4a0a76645941d8c7ba059940b3446228f0db8972#code and complete txlist [0,7281000] (1,447 rows) show latest unlockBuy at 6727544. This enables the selected funding purchase, but CAROL-to-WETH reserve reduction with pre-owned tokens remains permitted while buyLocked=true; it does not create the code defect or reset age. Other setters affect bond exposure/ownership, not the unsafe reserve read. Repository verifier --curve-ready reproduced all 12 declared anchor checks: PASS_ANCHORS on 2026-10-05 using configured Base archive RPC.

Anchor/root-cause/loss review: source-1 callTracer, excluding every reverted frame and its descendants, has one successful sell(0xe4849b32) and no reentrant CAROL call. The router pays the seller 35.257007142168513744 ETH before the callback sells CAROL into pair 0x0c477c729816228af3cb4e014cbf9412aa080b86; sell then burns 20,531.339208659430151309 protocol LP (receipt Transfer/Burn logs 24/26), removes 36.989881491171490158 ETH and buys CAROL back. Pool WETH balanceOf at blocks 7279799/7279800 is 33,647,459,623,314,536,802 / 70,302,585,613,936,664 wei; summed source-1 WETH Transfer logs for the pair independently reproduce depletion 33,577,157,037,700,600,138 wei. Source-5 sends 0.07 ETH to the helper and refunds 0.001; 0.069 funds a bond and stake. Its two committed router WETH transfers to the pool total 48,299,999,999,999,998 wei. Excluding all this identifiable campaign liquidity gives gross existing-victim depletion 33,528,857,037,700,600,140 wei WETH. Minted/supplied CAROL is attack financing, not a second victim-loss component; LP burn corroborates loss and is not valued again. Flash-loan fees, gas and attacker forwarding do not reduce gross depletion. Full sell history in source-6 establishes one successful campaign. Source-8 quotes ETH at $2,044.66, historical timestamp 1701348929, for a gross USD value of $68,555.11.
